statement: Every Residual Risk Assessment Result is a Risk Assessment Result.
Every Inherent Risk Assessment Result is a Risk Assessment Result.
Every Likelihood Assessment Result is a Risk Assessment Result.
Every Impact Assessment Result is a Risk Assessment Result.
Risk Owner is a role type, not an organization/person kind.
Risk Responsibility mediates/assigns an actor in an ownership/responsibility context.
Risk Register Entry is the same entity as Risk.
Scenario Description is the same entity as Risk Scenario or Risk Event.
Risk Assessment Activity is the same entity as Risk Assessment Result.
Residual Risk Assessment Result implies a distinct underlying Risk entity.
Workflow State = Closed entails Risk State = ceased/nonexistent.
An owner-field organization is a subclass of Risk Owner.
Control Mechanism is equivalent to Risk Treatment Strategy, Plan or Activity.
A source URL alone entails complete Provenance.
associatedWith entails causes.
COVER:Risk is equivalent to SemRisk Risk.
COVER/ROSE RiskAssessment is equivalent to SemRisk Risk Assessment Activity.
ROSE SecurityMechanism is equivalent to SemRisk Control Mechanism.
Enterprise evaluated Risk Register Entry has all fields required by its named profile.
Evaluated Assessment Result has required generating activity/provenance when profile requires it.
Derived hasRiskOwner returns actor only when qualifying Risk Responsibility assignment exists.
Workflow transition legality uses named workflow scheme, not Core OWL.
Risk score/classification changes when method/version inputs change as defined by method profile.
SQL query and SPARQL query for a parity case may differ in null/absence behavior and must document it.
